  cnt=$(grep -rnE "\b${name}\(" --include="*.go" . 2>/dev/null | grep -v "_test.go" | wc -l)
  echo "$cnt|$name|$path" >> /tmp/results.txt
done < /tmp/funcs.txt
sort -t'|' -k1,1 -nr /tmp/results.txt | head -40

Nothing else approached 28.

`(*renderer).addArg` — `internal/filter/render.go` — approx fan-in 28

This private helper method (used to register a bound SQL parameter and return its placeholder, e.g. `$1`/`?`) is invoked roughly 28 times throughout the various `render*`/`build*` condition-rendering methods in that same file, making it the single most-called function/method declared anywhere under `internal/` in this repository.
